fields.definitionEn: Barefoot vertical height from the floor to the marked high point shoulder at the neck base; this is not standing stature to the top of the head.
landmarks: high point shoulder at neck base
fields.posture: Standing barefoot, weight balanced, head natural, shoulders relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Use a rigid vertical rule or stadiometer projection from the marked high point shoulder to the floor; do not follow the torso surface.

fields.labelRu: от основания шеи до талии по центру переда
fields.definitionEn: Centre-front surface length from the suprasternal neck-base point to the marked natural waist plane.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with head forward, shoulders and abdomen relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Follow the centre-front body contour from the suprasternal point to the waist cord without suspending the tape.

fields.definitionEn: Barefoot vertical height from the floor to the level natural-waist plane.
fields.posture: Standing barefoot with feet together and weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Project the marked waist plane to a rigid vertical rule and read its perpendicular height above the floor.

fields.labelRu: от талии до верхней линии бёдер
fields.definitionEn: Vertical distance from the natural-waist plane to the selected high-hip plane.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with pelvis neutral and abdomen relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Measure the vertical separation at the side of the body; do not follow a curved waistband or body contour.

fields.definitionEn: Vertical distance from the natural-waist plane to the maximum-seat hip plane.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with pelvis neutral, feet together, and weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Measure the vertical separation at the side of the body; do not follow the body surface.

fields.definitionEn: Straight front-to-back torso depth on the same horizontal plane as the chest circumference.
fields.posture: Standing naturally at normal relaxed exhalation, shoulders not rounded.
fields.tapePath: Use an anthropometer or two parallel tangents; record the straight separation, not a surface arc.

fields.definitionEn: Straight front-to-back torso depth on the marked natural-waist plane.
fields.posture: Standing naturally at normal relaxed exhalation, abdomen relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Use parallel tangents and record their straight separation without compressing soft tissue.

fields.definitionEn: Straight front-to-back pelvic depth on the maximum-seat hip plane.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with feet together and weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Use parallel tangents and record the straight separation; do not follow the seat contour.

fields.definitionEn: Surface length from the high point shoulder at neck base to the acromion on the same side.
landmarks: high point shoulder at neck base
fields.posture: Standing naturally with shoulders relaxed and arms hanging.
fields.tapePath: Follow the top shoulder surface between the two marked points without extending onto the neck or upper arm.

fields.definitionEn: Vertical level difference between the high point shoulder at neck base and the same-side acromion.
landmarks: high point shoulder at neck base
fields.posture: Standing naturally with both shoulders relaxed; do not level or square the subject.
fields.tapePath: Project both landmarks to the same vertical reference and record their vertical difference, not the sloped shoulder length.

fields.definitionEn: Vertical distance from the high point shoulder level to the marked underarm level on the same side.
fields.posture: Standing naturally, shoulder relaxed, arm hanging after the underarm level is marked.
fields.tapePath: Measure the vertical level difference with a rigid reference; do not measure diagonally over the shoulder.

fields.definitionEn: Closed body-surface path around the shoulder joint through the marked shoulder and underarm landmarks.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with the arm relaxed slightly away only for tape placement, then lowered.
fields.tapePath: Pass the tape around the shoulder joint through all marked landmarks without including upper-arm circumference or garment ease.

fields.definitionEn: Front surface distance between the left and right marked bust apex points.
fields.posture: Standing naturally in the same close-fitting base layer used for the other bust measurements.
fields.tapePath: Lay the tape across the front surface between the two marked apex points without continuing around the torso.

fields.labelRu: от высшей точки плеча до центра груди
fields.definitionEn: Front surface length from the same-side high point shoulder at neck base to the marked bust apex.
landmarks: high point shoulder at neck base
fields.posture: Standing naturally with shoulders relaxed in the same base layer used to mark the bust apex.
fields.tapePath: Follow the front body surface from high point shoulder to bust apex without suspending the tape or crossing to the opposite side.

fields.definitionEn: Circumference of the neck at mid-length, in the plane perpendicular to the neck axis; a separate field from neck base and never derived from it.
fields.definitionRu: Обхват шеи на середине её длины, в плоскости, перпендикулярной оси шеи; отдельная мерка, не выводится из обхвата основания шеи.
landmarks: mid-length of the neck between the neck base and the jaw line
fields.posture: Head in a natural forward position, shoulders relaxed, jaw level.
fields.tapePath: Wrap the tape around the neck at mid-length, perpendicular to the neck axis and below the jaw; do not follow the sloped neck-base contour.

claimBoundary.note: This project-owned extension defines operator semantics only. It does not claim equivalence to a paid external standard or prove mannequin accuracy.
